changes: Approved edits are now the answer key for their recording: a rebuild can never quietly bring back a take you already cut (approved_cuts).

Draft self-check: every finished draft is transcribed and listened to for repeats and retakes before it's marked ready (draft_audit), and the camera that's really on screen is measured from the picture (shown_cam).
Intros: a new KV pixel-box intro template (assets/Graphics/HyperFrames/_templates/kv-pixelbox) and a bigger intro library.
Descriptions: the description writer follows the Top 5 / Top 10 format for list videos and only uses links already in the project's own files.
Player bar on every video: -10 s / +10 s and 1x / 1.5x / 2x speed that sticks.
Phone review page (Studio/ui/m.html): watch a draft and send notes from your phone while Studio runs on your PC.
Schedule a build: start a draft at a time you pick (project page: Schedule).
Everything builds on your own PC: no second machine, no other AI services. Claude only.
New video types: Haul (one long phone recording, 1080p60, beat per section, captions on intro + outro) and Short (raw vertical recordings: 1080x1920, tight trim, captions, hook headline, punch-ins).
Render queue: one GPU build at a time, a Queue page, live revision statuses, a smoother progress bar with ETA and a stuck warning.
Captions (opt-in, Settings): caption presets for Shorts and intros.
Music picker: chooses from your whole music folder by mood, no repeats across a channel's last 15 videos, vocal-scanned.
Intros: new templates (P21 glowing phone, R21 editor cut), a quality gate (intro_score / intro_check), named-site page scrolls, creator clips, product library, faster fix passes.
Review pipeline: cleaner joins (no mid-sentence starts, breath-tail joins), repeat guard, second-mic gap detection, B-roll per product, self-talk + retake cleanup.
Screen recordings: topic sections + music changes, cursor zooms on what you talk about.
Privacy: new on-screen personal-info scan + blur (pii_scan / pii_blur / pii_check).
Studio redesign (new look) and many speed-ups.
